You support sourcing, tendering, and contracting activities, including commercial negotiations with contractors, suppliers, and strategic partners. You drive contractual consistency across projects, contribute to standard contract development, and participate in project governance and risk reviews. Project Development You provide practical, business-oriented legal support across the full project lifecycle, from origination and development through construction and operations. raw.description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei? 
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. 

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.



Deine Position

Ob in den Kommentaren unserer Social-Media-Kanäle oder in Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google – überall dort entsteht ein Stück öffentliches Bild von 1KOMMA5°. Damit wir dort schnell, passend und im Sinne unserer Marke reagieren, suchen wir dich als Verstärkung für unser Community- und Bewertungsmanagement – mit Gespür für Sprache, Plattformen und den Menschen dahinter.


Community Management & Bewertungsmanagement (dein Hauptfokus)


  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Community-Betreuung auf Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn in der zeitnahen Beantwortung von Kommentaren und Nachrichten im Ton von 1KOMMA5°

  • Du unterstützt im operativen Bewertungsmanagement: Du screenst neue Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google, reportest Auffälligkeiten und hilfst bei der Implementierung entsprechender Maßnahmen

  • Du behältst wöchentlich das relevante Video-Umfeld auf YouTube im Blick, sichtest ausgewählte Kanäle und Beiträge rund um 1KOMMA5° und gibst deine Beobachtungen strukturiert ans Team weiter, damit bei Bedarf schnell die richtigen nächsten Schritte eingeleitet werden können

  • Du unterstüzt unsere Organic Traffic Machine: Direkt nachdem neue Inhalte auf unseren Kanälen live gehen, gehst du aktiv in die Kommentare unserer eigenen Posts, stößt Diskussionen an und sorgst so mit dafür, dass unsere Inhalte zusätzlich an Reichweite und Sichtbarkeit gewinnen

  • Du behältst die Logiken der einzelnen Plattformen im Blick – was auf LinkedIn funktioniert, funktioniert nicht automatisch auf Instagram – und kommunizierst dabei immer im Sinne von 1KOMMA5°

  • Du platzierst unsere Inhalte auch dort, wo sich Gespräche über Energiewende, PV, Wärmepumpen & Co. sowieso schon abspielen – zum Beispiel durch passende, wertstiftende Kommentare auf anderen Accounts


Dein Signature-Projekt: GEO


  • Du übernimmst bei uns das Thema GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) als eigenes kleines Projekt und bringst dich inhaltlich aktiv ein: Du entwickelst mit, wie unsere Social-Media- und Community-Inhalte so formuliert und aufbereitet werden, dass sie auch in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen und Antworten gut sichtbar sind

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, testest neue Formulierungsansätze und hilfst dabei, GEO nach und nach fest in unsere Content-Erstellung einzubauen


Dein Profil

  • Du bist noch mindestens zwei Semester an einer deutschen Hochschule im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, BWL oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert

  • Du bist selbst viel auf Social Media unterwegs und verstehst intuitiv, wie sich Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn jeweils unterscheiden – in Ton, Format und Zielgruppe

  • Erste Erfahrung im Community- oder Social-Media-Management ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – wichtiger ist uns dein Gespür für Sprache und Menschen.

  • Du schreibst sicher und stilsicher auf Deutsch, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Social-Media-Management-Tools wie Agorapulse (oder vergleichbaren Tools) ist hilfreich

  • Ein Grundverständnis von SEO bzw. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ist ein Plus – vor allem aber hast du Lust, dich in dieses Thema als eigenes kleines Projekt einzuarbeiten und es aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Du interessierst dich für die Energiewende und hast Lust, dieses Thema jeden Tag ein Stück greifbarer zu machen


Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unserem schicken Showroom in der Hamburger Innenstadt zu arbeiten und/oder remote
  • Einblicke in das Community Management eines der am schnellsten wachsenden CleanTech-Startups Europas

  • Ein Team, das dir Fragen beantwortet, Feedback gibt und dich in die Plattform- und Tool-Logiken einarbeitet

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen

  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzial, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP or Oracle. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows. Tasks Own the integration architecture for new customers end to end: assess their ERP landscape, choose the right interface pattern (OData, RFC/BAPI, IDoc/EDI, CPI/BTP, staging tables, file-based), and design something their IT will approve and operate. Lead technical discovery with customer IT, basis, and process teams, and surface the blocking constraint in week one, not week nine. Own the data and field mapping from the customer's order, item, partner, and pricing structures onto our internal model, including the custom fields that carry the real business logic. Design and build our ERP connectors in Python (S/4HANA and ECC, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce) and turn per-customer work into reusable abstractions, so the tenth connector costs a fraction of the first. Build durable, long-running integration workflows with safe write-back into customer systems of record: idempotency, retries, replay semantics, and recovery paths from the start. Own integration observability: know when a sync is stuck, degraded, or silently writing the wrong thing before the customer notices. Define the authentication, network, and security posture per customer and get it through their review. Feed what you learn in customer landscapes back into the product. You will see the same five problems before anyone else does. Requirements ERP integration depth, non-negotiable: you have delivered productive ERP integrations and know the interface landscape first-hand (IDoc, BAPI/RFC, OData/Gateway, CPI/BTP Integration Suite), on both S/4HANA and ECC, and you know which one to reach for and why. Functional grounding: fluent in at least one of SD (order-to-cash) or MM (procure-to-pay), credible in the other, plus the FI touchpoints for AP/AR. You know what a schedule line, a condition record, and a three-way match actually are. Engineering, not just configuration: 5+ years building and operating backend systems with real Python depth, owning production services rather than just delivering features. Reliability instinct: idempotency, retries, and observability are part of how you design, not afterthoughts. A workflow engine like Temporal in production is a strong plus. Customer-facing credibility: you can stand in front of an enterprise IT department, absorb their constraints, push back where it matters, and leave them confident. End-to-end ownership: you identify what's broken or missing before you're asked, and you don't leave the system worse than you found it. Professional English; German is a strong advantage given our customer base. You're happy being in the office five days a week. Schließe dich GeneralMind an, um als ERP Integration Experte die Zukunft von KI und Unternehmen mitzugestalten. Werde Teil eines innovativen Teams in Berlin! title: Senior Backend Engineer – Agentic Systems (m/f/d)
description: What we look for: You build the production backbone that enables our Forward Deployed AI Engineers (FDEs) to turn agentic workflows into secure, reliable, measurable, and reusable customer solutions. You design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, queues, databases, and distributed systems using Python, TypeScript, or comparable technologies. You create robust orchestration patterns for agentic systems, including tool calling, stateful workflows, routing, retries, human approvals, and context management. You build and maintain integrations with enterprise systems and SaaS applications, including OAuth, webhooks, SDKs, API clients, and data ingestion pipelines. You ensure production reliability through resilient error handling, idempotent design, rate-limit management, fallbacks, audit logs, and effective incident debugging. You develop evaluation and observability capabilities, including test datasets, trace capture, quality metrics, structured logging, workflow-level dashboards, and cost and latency monitoring. You establish shared platform primitives, templates, security standards, and governance patterns that accelerate each new FDE deployment while protecting customer data. What we require: You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. You have 4-6 years of experience in backend engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, or comparable software engineering roles. You have strong hands-on programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or both, and a solid understanding of modern software engineering best practices. You have experience designing and operating scalable APIs, asynchronous systems, queues, databases, and distributed services in production environments. You are familiar with enterprise integrations, including OAuth, webhooks, REST APIs, SDKs, and data ingestion or normalisation pipelines. You have practical experience with LLM or agentic application patterns, such as tool calling, orchestration, state management, retrieval, evaluation, or observability. You are fluent in English and able to communicate technical topics clearly with engineers, FDEs, and client stakeholders; additional local language skills are a plus. Your working environment: You will be immersed in a diverse and family-friendly environment with a strong team spirit, benefitting from a flexible and hybrid working model in one of our offices in Munich, London, Amsterdam, Milan, Paris and Berlin. Your view into the future: You will work at the cutting edge and gain valuable insights and practical experience with a focus on digital business models and data-driven value creation in eight forward-looking industries. Your benefits on top: You can look forward to regular team events and joint sports sessions, an attractive company pension scheme, access to local fitness and wellness partnerships as well as mobility and meal allowances and a wide range of other company benefits. Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine, Getränke und frisches Obst stehen ebenfalls für dich bereit. Zeit fürs Team: Zweiwöchentliches Breakfast, Afterwork Drinks, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier. C-Level-Interview & Case (ca. 60 Min) Abschließendes Gespräch mit Marcus (CEO und Founder) und Christian inklusive Case. Dabei kannst du zeigen, wie du an konkrete Fragestellungen herangehst und deine Perspektive auf die Rolle einbringen. Gleiche Chancen für alle Bei 42watt leben wir eine offene und inklusive Unternehmenskultur. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Diversität und Gleichberechtigung der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg sind. title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben. Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz. Was dich erwartet Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases. Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap. Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase. Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit. Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact. Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales. Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen. Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle. Das solltest du mitbringen Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung. Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus. Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln. Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken. Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt. Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung. Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt. Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten. Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche. Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden. Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich. Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit. Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
description: What is Jedox? Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes. Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed. Your Responsibilities As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day. What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap : Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities. Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments. Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions. Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls. Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes. Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions. Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability. Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution. Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities. Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction. What Success Looks Like in Your First Year Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets. Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences. A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders. Your Profile 3–5 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments. Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products. title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d) - Vollzeit, vor Ort in Lingen
description: Du schaust auf einen Ad Account und siehst nach zwei Minuten, wo es hakt? Welcher Angle als Nächstes dran ist, welche Hook fehlt, warum der Winner gerade abbaut? Dann lies weiter. Wer wir sind Commerce Ventures ist die führende Performance-Marketing-Agentur, im Food, Health und Beverage Bereich. Wir betreuen ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen, von Gründern und Gründerinnen, die ambitioniert sind und wirklich coole Produkte entwickelt haben. Monatlich laufen sechsstellige Meta-Budgets über unsere Accounts, und wir haben mehr als eine Brand von null auf achtstellig begleitet. Der Hebel dahinter ist immer das Creative. Dafür haben wir ein Modell gebaut, das funktioniert: klare Prozesse, klare Zahlen, klare Verantwortung, und Leute, die liefern. Kein Agentur-Bullshit, keine 40-seitigen Decks. Was du machst Du übernimmst deine eigenen Brands, in kompletter Eigenverantwortung, drei bis vier Brands maximal, damit du dich voll und ganz auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden konzentrieren kannst. Du übernimmst die komplette Creative Strategy, Media Buying, Kunden-Calls, Planung. Du briefst unsere Post-Production, du entscheidest, was live geht, du weißt jeden Morgen, was die Zahlen sagen und was heute zu tun ist. Damit wir uns nicht falsch verstehen: Wir suchen keinen Strategen, der Konzepte präsentiert und andere machen lässt. Du setzt die Strategie und lieferst selbst: Angles, Hooks, Skripte, Briefings, Statics. Wer lieber Slides baut und mehr redet als macht, ist bei uns falsch. Wie wir arbeiten Wir sind ein kleines Team, remote aufgestellt, und trotzdem haben wir gerade unser Büro in Lingen vergrößert. Warum? Weil die Lernkurve neben Gründer und Team im Office steiler ist als in jedem Google-Meet. Wer die Rolle vor Ort macht, lernt es von denen, die es jeden Tag machen! Und bekommt JUUZ und Prepmymeal Meals im Kühlschrank obendrauf. Heißt aber nicht, dass remote nicht geht. Wenn du gut bist und selbstständig arbeitest können wir reden. Lingen ist unser Wunsch, aber nicht die Bedingung. Was bei uns gilt: Wir arbeiten hart, weil gemeinsam Ziele erreichen, Spaß macht! Wir sagen uns direkt, was Sache ist. Und wir feiern, wenn ein Kunde den Umsatz verdoppelt. Kurz, unser Motto: doing cool shit with cool people! Aufgaben Du verantwortest die Creative- und Funnel-Strategie für deine Accounts: von der Analyse über den Testplan bis zum fertigen Creative. Du analysierst die Ad Accounts, findest die Lücken (fehlende Angles, , schwache Hooks, schwache Landingpages) und leitest daraus konkrete Testpläne ab. Du entscheidest, was als Nächstes launcht, und priorisierst nach Wirkunk und nicht nach Bauchgefühl. Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Ad Copy selbst und baust Statics und Animations, wenn der Account sie braucht. Du briefst UGC-Creator, Editoren und unsere Post-Production und challengst sie so lange, bis die Creatives performen. Du führst deine Kunden-Calls selbst, präsentierst Zahlen und hast den vollen Überblick über deine Accounts (maximal drei). Du iterierst Winner weiter und leitest aus den Performance-Daten die nächste Version ab. Du arbeitest täglich mit Claude und Co., baust dir eigene Prompts und Workflows und nutzt AI, um schneller und besser zu liefern als der Markt. Qualifikation Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Media Buyer, Direct-Response-Marketer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im D2C- bzw. E-Commerce-Bereich. Du denkst in Funnels, Awareness Stages (Schwartz), Angles und Hypothesen, nicht in Branding-Kampagnen. Du hast Creatives, Hooks, Skripte oder Funnels nicht nur konzipiert, sondern selbst gebaut, und sie haben performt. Du arbeitest datengetrieben und schaust auf die Zahlen: ROAS, CAC, CTR, Hook-Rate, Hold-Rate. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit KI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Magnific und Co.) oder brennst darauf, sie in deinen Workflow zu bauen. Du ziehst Themen eigenständig durch, lieferst sauber und gibst Gas, auch wenn keiner zuschaut. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du redest nicht über Ideen, du setzt sie um. Du willst vor Ort arbeiten, in Lingen (Ems) oder Umgebung. Lebenslauf, Studium oder Titel auf dem Papier sind uns egal. Deine Erfahrung und Expertise zählt, sowie dein Character. Benefits Eine Lernkurve, die es so kaum irgendwo gibt: 6-stellige Meta-Budgets, direkter Draht zum Gründer, Feedback in Tagen statt in Quartalen. Ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen: Food, Health und Supplements. Keine Kunden, für die du dich rechtfertigen musst. Geiles Office in Lingen, ein Ort, an dem man wirklich gerne arbeitet. Neueste Hardware (Apple-Universum) und der komplette AI-Stack, den du brauchst. JUUZ & Prepmymeal-Vorrat im Kühlschrank Attraktives Fixum plus Performance-Bonus Ergebnisse vor Anwesenheit: flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege, keine Konzern-Bürokratie. Neue Arbeitskultur, positive Vibes, Hands-on statt Meeting-Marathon. Die Chance, den Creative-Bereich einer wachsenden Agentur mitzugestalten und später ein eigenes Team zu führen. Bis hierhin durchgelesen? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match. Schick uns ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du: Was hast du bisher gebaut, welche Creatives, Hooks oder Funnels von dir haben am besten performt, ab wann könntest du starten? Portfolio, Ad-Beispiele, Loom: immer her damit. Bitte kein 5-Seiten-Roman mit "teamfähig und belastbar", sondern kurz und knapp zeigen, wer du bist und was du drauf hast. Wenn du magst, nimm ein kurzes Video auf und beantworte zwei Fragen: Wer bist du? Und warum sollte man dich unbedingt im Team haben? Danach lernen wir uns 15 Minuten kennen und schauen, ob es passt. Ich freue mich besonders auf Leute aus Lingen und Umgebung. Liebe Grüße, Marek Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Finance Manager Germany (m/w/d)
description: Finance bekommt Ihre Handschrift. Was würden Sie aufbauen, wenn Sie Finance für ein wachsendes Deutschlandgeschäft gestalten könnten? Als businessnaher Senior Finance Manager entwickeln Sie die Finance-Funktion der deutschen Niederlassung eines internationalen Generikaherstellers. Sie sind die zentrale Finance-Person vor Ort und gestalten mit dem Country Manager die nächsten Schritte des Geschäfts. Der Konzern verfügt über eigene Wirkstoff- und Arzneimittelherstellung. Vielleicht liegt Ihr Schwerpunkt heute in Commercial Finance, Controlling oder FP&A. Vielleicht verbinden Sie Finance und Markt bereits im Pricing, Tender Management, Pharmagroßhandel oder Arzneimittelimport. Entscheidend sind Ihr fundiertes Finance-Profil und praktische Erfahrung mit der Finanzmechanik des deutschen Generikageschäfts. Auch eine frühere Station kann dafür die Grundlage sein. ANDRIS Consulting begleitet die Besetzung als Personalberatung im Auftrag des Unternehmens. Die Anstellung erfolgt beim Auftraggeber. Aufgaben Geschäftsideen weiterentwickeln: Sie bewerten neue Produkte und Marketinginitiativen, rechnen Szenarien durch und erarbeiten mit dem Country Manager Empfehlungen für Investitionen. Gross-to-net verantworten: Sie gestalten die Prozesse rund um Krankenkassenrabatte, stimmen Forderungen ab und sorgen für nachvollziehbare Rückstellungen, Preisprüfungen und Freigaben. Tender wirtschaftlich bewerten: Gemeinsam mit dem Head of Tender Management prüfen Sie Kalkulationen und gestalten tragfähige Angebote. Sie machen die Auswirkungen von Preisannahmen und Kosten auf die Marge sichtbar. Finance mit dem Geschäft entwickeln: Sie verbessern Reporting und Abläufe, erkennen Risiken früh und begleiten die Umsetzung. Dabei arbeiten Sie auch mit Supply Chain und Logistik zusammen. Planung und Liquidität steuern: Sie gestalten Forecasts mit Vertrieb und Supply Chain. Treasury und die laufende Liquiditätsübersicht für Deutschland verantworten Sie gemeinsam mit dem europäischen Finance-Team. Das finanzielle Fundament sichern: Mit internen und externen Fachleuten stellen Sie Steuer- und Statistikmeldungen sicher, einschließlich Umsatz- und Körperschaftsteuer, und begleiten die Abschlussprüfung. Qualifikation Fundiertes Finance-Profil: Mindestens zehn Jahre Finance-Erfahrung, gerne auch in geschäftsnahen Aufgaben innerhalb von Pricing, Tender Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen. Praktische Deutschland-Generika-Erfahrung: Sie kennen Gross-to-net, Krankenkassenrabatte und Rückstellungen aus eigener Arbeit und können Tender wirtschaftlich bewerten. Diese Erfahrung kann auch aus einer früheren Position oder einer passenden Aufgabe im Pharmagroßhandel beziehungsweise Arzneimittelimport stammen. Freude am Business: Sie denken Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch, vertreten Ihre Empfehlungen und möchten gemeinsam etwas aufbauen. Strategischer Blick und eigene Umsetzung gehören für Sie zusammen. Sicheres Handwerk: Sehr gutes Excel und praktische Erfahrung mit SAP. Sie erklären wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge verständlich. Deutsch und Englisch: Deutsch mindestens auf B2-Niveau, C1 bevorzugt, sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Hilfreiche Ergänzungen: Weiterführende Accounting- oder betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikationen sowie Erfahrung mit dem Aufbau von Prozessen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen sind willkommen. Benefits Gestaltung in Deutschland: Sie übernehmen lokale Finance-Verantwortung und entwickeln die finanzielle Steuerung auf Basis vorhandener Prozesse weiter. Nähe zu Geschäftsentscheidungen: Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Country Manager und dem Tender Management. Vor Ort berichten Sie an den Country Manager, fachlich an die europäische Finance-Leitung. Zusammenarbeit in Frankfurt am Main: Hier entstehen Strategie und gemeinsame Entscheidungen. Gesucht ist jemand, der diesen persönlichen Austausch schätzt und vor Ort etwas entwickeln möchte. Hybrid mit individueller Abstimmung: Ergänzende Remote-Anteile schaffen Spielraum für Beruf und Familie. Die Ausgestaltung stimmen Sie anhand der Aufgabe und Ihrer persönlichen Situation gemeinsam ab. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht vorgesehen. Das Vergütungspaket besprechen wir im persönlichen Austausch. Was reizt Sie daran, Finance in Deutschland zu entwickeln? Nutzen Sie die Bewerbungsfunktion und schreiben Sie uns ein paar Sätze dazu. Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen Sie für den Einstieg nicht. Wir melden uns kurzfristig und behandeln Ihr Interesse vertraulich. Christoph Andris ANDRIS Consulting · Pharma Executive Search Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
description: AlphaPrompt ist ein Münchner B2B-Software-Startup für die institutionelle Immobilienwirtschaft. Unsere Plattform hat zwei Säulen: einen intelligenten Datenraum, der das Dokumentenmanagement vollständig automatsiert, und einen Agentic Workspace, in dem KI-Agenten Prüfungen und Workflows übernehmen – von Mietverträgen über Nebenkostenabrechnungen bis zur Übergabe in Drittsysteme. Unsere Kunden sind derzeit über 50 (institutionelle) Asset- und Property-Manager in der DACH-Region, wir expandieren gerade aber in weitere Märkte. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Du entwickelst die Plattform als solche weiter, damit AlphaPrompt im Kundenalltag reibungslos läuft: Vom Import bis zum Export, in enger Abstimmung mit unserem AI-Team mit dem Ziel: sauber integriert, getestet, für den Kunden nutzbar. Du arbeitest im Plattform-Team mit unserem Lead-Entwickler und eng mit den Gründern zusammen – und bekommst keine fertig zerlegten Kleinst-Tickets, sondern Themen mit Kontext und den Freiraum, sie selbst zu Ende zu denken. Was du bei uns machst Features über den ganzen Stack bauen – Backend in Python, Frontend in React – von der Idee bis zum Deployment. KI-Funktionen und Agenten unseres AI-Teams in die Plattform integrieren – und verstehen, was dahinter passiert. Das Onboarding neuer Kunden und Objekte vereinfachen: Konfiguration, die heute außerhalb passiert, in die Plattform bringen; Integrationen stabil weiterentwickeln. Ergebnisse selbst prüfen und Kundenfeedback direkt in Verbesserungen übersetzen. Perspektivisch, wenn du willst: Ergebnisse direkt mit dem Kunden abstimmen. Qualifikation Was du mitbringst Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise an einem SaaS-Produkt. Full-Stack mit Schwerpunkt Backend (Python) – und du greifst auch ins Frontend (React/TypeScript), statt einen Bogen darum zu machen. Produktverständnis: Du willst wissen, wofür ein Feature da ist, nimmst dir Themen eigenständig und denkst mit, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten. Grundverständnis für LLM- und Agenten-basierte Anwendungen Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch für die Arbeit mit deutschen Dokumenten, im Team und perspektivisch mit Kunden; gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit im Team. Du bist in München (oder ziehst her), willst im Office arbeiten und hast den Drive, dich hinzusetzen und zu bauen – schnell, pragmatisch, sauber. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit ereignisgetriebenen Architekturen und Cloud-Betrieb, mit Dokumentenverarbeitung, OCR oder LLM-APIs – und Lust auf Kundenkontakt. Benefits Was wir bieten Ein Produkt, das bei institutionellen Kunden im Einsatz ist – du siehst direkt, was dein Code beim Kunden bewirkt. Kurze Wege: direkt mit den Gründern und dem Lead-Entwickler, Entscheidungen fallen im Raum, nicht im Ticket. KI als Kern des Produkts, nicht als Buzzword – mit der Möglichkeit, dich Richtung KI-Entwicklung oder Kundenprojekte weiterzuentwickeln. Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag, Büro in München und eine faire Vergütung. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Paid Social Manager
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, you’ll: Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. UA Manager Salary range: €65,000-80,000/annum We're looking for a Paid Social Manager to take ownership of our core app user acquisition channels. This is a high-stakes, hands-on role built for someone who lives in the data, moves fast on optimizations, and knows how to scale app campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, and TikTok. You'll be managing significant budgets across live campaigns — this is not a planning role. It requires daily attention, sharp instincts, and the ability to diagnose and fix performance problems in real time. What You'll Do 🎯 Own App UA at Scale: Take ownership of app install campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and DSPs - managing $500k+ in daily spend and optimizing toward revenue and predictive LTV targets. Drive Daily Performance: Monitor live campaigns daily, make proactive budget and bid adjustments, and troubleshoot performance drops without waiting to be asked. Lead Creative Strategy: Analyze top-performing creatives and competitive trends, identify what's working on TikTok and Facebook, and plan a balanced production mix of iterations and new concepts. Manage a Creative Ecosystem: Coordinate with our internal creative team - briefing, reviewing, and prioritizing production to keep testing pipelines moving. Navigate Attribution Complexity: Work across multiple campaign types, manage cross-channel attribution windows and settings, and use Adjust MMP to ensure clean app tracking and accurate performance reads. Build Toward LTV: Set and optimize against primary KPIs rooted in revenue and predictive lifetime value - understanding not just surface metrics but the downstream signals that predict real business impact. What You'll Bring 💡 App UA Track Record: Proven experience scaling app install campaigns across at least two of: AppLovin, Unity, Snapchat, Facebook, TikTok, or programmatic DSPs - with meaningful budget responsibility. Spend-Scale Comfort: You've managed large daily budgets in a live environment and know how to operate with both precision and speed when campaigns are actively running. Creative Judgment: You can analyze performance data to identify what creative is working, brief agencies effectively, and plan a testing roadmap that balances iteration with new concepts. Attribution Fluency: Solid understanding of mobile attribution, MMP setup (Adjust preferred), and how different campaign types and attribution windows interact — especially across app and web. LTV & Revenue Focus: Experience optimizing toward revenue-based KPIs and predictive LTV, ideally in gaming or subscription apps. If you don't have gaming background, you need to clearly demonstrate you understand the metrics that drive performance downstream. Problem-Solving Operator: You diagnose, you act, you iterate. You don't wait for weekly reviews to catch a problem — you're in the account daily and you fix things before they become fires. What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟 You treat a live campaign like it's always your responsibility - proactive, not reactive. You think in signals and ratios, not just top-line spend. You're a confident stakeholder manager who can align internal teams and external agencies toward a shared creative and performance roadmap. You're comfortable with complexity - multiple campaign types, channels, and attribution layers - and you build clarity from it rather than getting slowed down by it. Why Almedia? 🎁 Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success. Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one. Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin. Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. description: <p><strong>Location</strong><br>Our Engineering Manager - Revenue Management Azure House will be an integral part of our global R&amp;D team.<br>This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong><br>DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. <br>Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.<br>With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong><br>The Engineering Manager is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You are embedded with your team - daily standup, code review, architectural calls, delivery planning, and performance management - and you own both the team's output and the team's growth.<br>This is a genuinely technical &amp; leadership role. You are expected to write and review code, be a credible voice in architectural decisions, and stay current in your team's stack. You lead by demonstrating you can do the work at the highest level, not by title alone.The balance between hands-on contribution and leadership depends on the team's context, but your overarching mandate is the same: run the team, execute and deliver, and grow its impact. <br>Build the bench, raise the standard, and keep the operating cadence sharp as the work and the organization evolve. You work AI-augmented yourself, expect the same from your team, and push the team's craft forward with every new capability that lands.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities</strong><br><strong>Team leadership &amp; growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading a team of engineers, owning both its delivery and its development.</li> <li>Lead a mindset and process of continuous improvement within the team and meaningfully impact the team’s success over time. Small, compounding improvements, delivered via fast iterations, are the operating rhythm we expect, not an aspiration.</li> <li>You are responsible for the professional well-being and career development of team members. Develop engineers through regular 1:1s, growth plans, performance reviews, and direct, candid feedback.</li> <li>Develop the next layer of leadership - tech leads, senior engineers ready to manage, and ICs ready to step into staff roles.<br><br><strong>Technical leadership</strong></li> <li>Write code and review code. Be a credible voice in technical decisions because you have hands in the work, not because of your title - you are current, not rusty.</li> <li>Drive the team's architectural and technical design decisions in partnership with senior ICs, ensuring alignment on approach and implementation.</li> <li>Uphold engineering standards through thorough, constructive pull-request review and a healthy release process, keeping the team's components scalable and in a healthy state.</li> <li>Work AI-augmented and lead an AI-augmented team, applying sharp judgment about where AI helps and holding the same quality bar for what ships.<br><br><strong>Roadmap &amp; delivery</strong></li> <li>Own the team's commitments - what was promised, when it was promised, and the quality bar that was held.</li> <li>Run a disciplined cadence of planning, prioritization, and delivery without becoming a process bureaucrat.</li> <li>Partner closely with the Technical Product Owner and Product team on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, maintaining a roadmap that reflects both near-term priorities and longer-term direction.</li> <li>Understand the broader business objectives behind the work, translate that context for the team, and ensure engineering effort clearly aligns with those objectives.</li> <li>React decisively to change - re-planning, re-prioritizing, and re-staffing as the business moves - while keeping the team engaged and steady through the shift.<br><br><strong>Hiring </strong></li> <li>Own hiring for your team. Interview thoughtfully, decide quickly, and refuse to lower the bar to fill seats.</li> <li>Recruit, coach, and - when needed - make hard calls toward the standard the team is held to.</li> <li>Operate as a role model for other engineering managers across the organization: share your operating model, mentor peers, and raise the management bench.</li> <li>Day-to-day communication &amp; collaborationUpwards: Communicate clearly and succinctly, giving leadership the right level of context and prioritizing escalations based on relevant, well-gathered information.</li> <li>Downwards: Empower senior engineers to own key areas of the product, and coach team members to stay focused, intentional, and aware of their impact.</li> <li>Sideways: Partner effectively with Product, Design, GTM, Customer Success, and other teams - raising challenges and opportunities constructively to support cross-team alignment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications </strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering management roles where you actively coded as part of your responsibilities.</li> <li>Hands-on, real-life experience building cloud-based SaaS products - running services in production for Azure (and ideally additionally on AWS/GCP) , and owning availability, cost, and the customer-facing surface</li> <li>Strong background in understanding and leading teams in the FinOps space.</li> <li>API first mindset, products are built not just for end user experience through UI,they are fully functional and available through APIs, so both humans and agents can interact with the platform.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong background in engineering management of multi-disciplinary teams, including full-stack engineers and data engineers.</li> <li>A track record of taking an engineering team and visibly transforming it - measurable improvements in delivery velocity, technical quality, or team caliber.</li> <li>Deep technical fluency in your team's primary stack. You can read, write, and review code at a senior level, and you are current - not rusty.</li> <li>Strong opinions on how high-performing engineering teams operate, and a clear philosophy on hiring, coaching, performance management, and technical decision-making.</li> <li>Excellent judgment under pressure. You make calls quickly with imperfect information, communicate them clearly, and take responsibility for the outcomes.</li> <li>Direct, candid communication. You give hard feedback well, and you hear it well.<br><br><strong>Bonus Points</strong></li> <li>&nbsp;Strong Golang knowledge or experience</li> <li>A strong, already-established AI-augmented workflow, with opinions on how to apply AI tools and agentic workflows to raise both velocity and quality.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with more than a single cloud provider.</li> <li>Background in scaling teams, processes, or technical systems as the organization grows.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Are you a Do’er?</strong><br>Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. <br>We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.&nbsp; <br>What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our&nbsp;<a href="https://careers.doit.com/life-at-doit/">core values</a>. <br><br>Sounds too good to be true? Check out our<a href="https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-DoiT-International-EI_IE1972488.11,29.htm"> Glassdoor Page</a>.<br>We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.&nbsp;</p> <p>Full-time employee benefits include:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited Vacation</li> <li>Flexible Working Options</li> <li>Health Insurance</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Stock Option Plan</li> <li>Home Office Allowance</li> <li>Professional Development Stipend&nbsp;</li> <li>Peer Recognition Program</li> </ul> <p><strong>Many Do’ers, One Team</strong><br>DoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Optimove, we believe people are capable of more than a single job description. You’re not hired just to fill a position- you’re empowered to shape it, grow it, and make it your own.<br>We call this being Positionless.<br>And Positionless isn’t just our culture. It’s our product.<br>Optimove is the creator of Positionless Marketing, an AI-powered platform that gives every marketer the power to analyze, create, launch, and optimize independently. The result is faster execution, deeper personalization, and 88% greater campaign efficiency.<br>Recognized as a Visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant, we partner with leading brands like Sephora, Staples, and Entain. Today, more than 500 Optimovers across NYC, London, Tel Aviv, Scotland, Brazil, Estonia, and beyond are building the future of marketing together, in an environment that actively encourages ownership and growth, with two out of every three managers promoted from within.<br>If you’re looking for a place where you can do more, be more, come grow with us.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Customer Data Engineer, you will be a part of a strong energetic and fast-growing global team. You will be an integral part of clients' ongoing data requests and projects. You will be working closely with internal CSM teams as well as interacting directly with clients’ data teams across different business verticals. Your core responsibilities will involve playing an active role in collaborating with internal teams to construct tailored data transformations and manipulations while working with top-notch technology (Cloud tech etc.) The ideal candidate is an SQL whiz with a strong work ethic, robust analytical and technical capabilities, and highly effective time management skills. We are looking for a master multi-tasker who thrives in challenging, fast-paced environments, with agility and ease.</p> <p>The Customer Data Engineer is a position that brings with it an excellent opportunity to learn and grow within a rapidly expanding company on the cutting edge of Martech.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:&nbsp;</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Develop and support a wide range of data transformations and migrations</li> <li>Construct custom ETL processes: Design and implementation of data pipelines and data marts, access versatile data sources, and apply data quality measures</li> <li>Investigate data mismatches and apply solutions</li> <li>Work side by side and support the Customer Success teams in order to meet customer business needs.</li> <li>Interact with clients to understand business needs and collaborate on project scopes, planning, and execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Requirements:</u></strong> </p> <ul> <li>1-3 years of experience in a similar technical client-facing position, <strong>OR </strong>graduate with a degree in STEM</li> <li>Experience with databases and SQL - a Must</li> <li>Outstanding technical and analytical skills</li> <li>Highly motivated with an exceptional work ethic</li> <li>High attention to detail with an ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills</li> <li>Quick, self-learning capabilities and creativity in problem-solving</li> <li>This is a hybrid role, and you will be required in our Dundee office 2 days per week</li> <li>Must be eligible to work in the UK – we are unable to provide sponsorship at this time&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred: </strong> </p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with Python</li> <li>Familiarity with Airflow, ETL tools, Snowflake and MSSQL</li> <li>Hands-on with VCS (Git)</li> <li>Genuinely curious and already reaching for AI tools to work smarter (or itching to). This matters to us more than it might elsewhere</li> </ul> <p>Optimove offers a vibrant, people‑first culture where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning shape everything we do. Our UK team enjoys a modern office with a hybrid work model, daily lunch budget when onsite, and a fully stocked kitchen, along with a wide range of social events throughout the year. We’re committed to helping our people grow in an inclusive, supportive workplace recognised as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Tech and for Wellbeing.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Optimove is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants fairly, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.<br><br><br>By submitting this application, you agree that Optimove will process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR. For details, see our <a href="https://www.optimove.com/legal/privacy-policy" target="_blank">Privacy Policy</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

unique in our approach. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:145,&quot;335559740&quot;:264}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body" data-ccp-parastyle-defn="{&quot;ObjectId&quot;:&quot;baa2b379-a6d3-56f4-af2b-6a08de9434e5|1&quot;,&quot;ClassId&quot;:1073872969,&quot;Properties&quot;:[469777841,&quot;Aeonik&quot;,469777842,&quot;Aeonik&quot;,469777843,&quot;Aeonik&quot;,469777844,&quot;Aeonik&quot;,469769226,&quot;Aeonik&quot;,201342446,&quot;1&quot;,201342447,&quot;5&quot;,201342448,&quot;1&quot;,201342449,&quot;1&quot;,201341986,&quot;1&quot;,268442635,&quot;20&quot;,335551500,&quot;197122&quot;,335559740,&quot;264&quot;,201341983,&quot;0&quot;,335559738,&quot;145&quot;,469775450,&quot;FIR Body&quot;,201340122,&quot;2&quot;,134234082,&quot;true&quot;,134233614,&quot;true&quot;,469778129,&quot;FIRBody&quot;,335572020,&quot;1&quot;,469778324,&quot;Body Text&quot;]}">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">to deliver energy-efficient AI&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">compute</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">&nbsp;at scale to customers.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:145,&quot;335559740&quot;:264}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">proprietary, and built to scale.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:145,&quot;335559740&quot;:264}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Roles &amp; Responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development at Firmus, you will lead the electrical engineering discipline across every site where Firmus is building and scaling an AI Factory. This is a principal-engineer-equivalent management role within the Build group, accountable for the consistent, high-quality implementation of Firmus's reference electrical design across our global site portfolio.</p> <p>The role sits within AI Factory Development (Build) and reports to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering. You will lead a distributed team of site-based electrical engineers across Indonesia, Australia, and any future geography where Firmus is active. Your remit is delivery, governance, and technical assurance of the electrical design in construction, commissioning, and handover — not ownership of the reference design itself, though you will be a primary and continuous input into the reference design's evolution.</p> <p>This is a central leadership role. You are the single accountable owner for electrical engineering execution across the Firmus AI Factory estate, the escalation point for electrical technical issues in the field, and the guardian of design intent from tender through energisation. You will work in tight partnership with the reference design owners, the Mechanical and Thermal, Controls, and Physical Networking Heads, and with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations to ensure every site is electrically built, tested, and handed over to standard.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <p>As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development, you will own the electrical engineering function within the AI Factory Development group. You will define how the reference electrical design is interpreted, adapted for local codes and site conditions, procured, constructed, and commissioned across every Firmus site. You will set the technical bar for MV/LV distribution, UPS and standby generation, protection and coordination, earthing and bonding, power quality, and the electrical interfaces to liquid-cooled AI compute halls.</p> <p>You will act as the engineering authority for electrical execution across the AI Factory portfolio — accountable for design governance in the field, deviation management, factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning readiness, and safe, reliable energisation. You will operate the change-control and design-review disciplines that keep every site aligned to the Firmus reference design, and you will be the escalation point when local realities require considered deviation or when the reference design itself needs to evolve.</p> <p>You will not own the development of the reference electrical design, but you will be one of its most important customers and contributors. You will feed operational learnings, site constraints, vendor performance data, and commissioning findings back into the reference design owners, and you will co-develop the electrical standards, templates, and Basis of Design updates that keep Firmus's design ahead of the industry.</p> <p>You will build, lead, and scale a geographically distributed electrical engineering team – site-based engineers embedded in Indonesia, Australia, and any additional geography where Firmus operates. You will set the operating rhythm across time zones, establish consistent engineering practice and quality standards across sites, develop the next generation of senior electrical engineers within Firmus, and represent electrical engineering in cross-functional Build, Commissioning, and Operations forums.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Experiences</strong></p> <p>You are, first and foremost, an accomplished electrical engineer for mission-critical, high-density digital infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, standby and prime-power generation, static and rotary switching, protection and relay coordination, arc-flash and safety-in-design, earthing and bonding, and the specific electrical demands of dense GPU compute halls and liquid-cooled AI infrastructure. You understand power system modelling — load flow, short-circuit, motor starting, transient stability — and you have used it to make consequential design and operational decisions.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading tender design reviews, consultant and contractor governance, factory acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, level-1 through level-5 commissioning, and handover to operations. You have authored or materially shaped Basis of Design documents, engineering templates, global minimum standards, and change-control processes at a hyperscale operator or equivalent. You are comfortable engaging utilities, regulators, and major equipment vendors, and you know how to drive value engineering, DfMA, and sustainability outcomes without compromising reliability.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under construction and commissioning pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of site engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI infrastructure that works reliably from day one.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in electrical power engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (power systems preferred) recognised in at least one of Firmus's operating jurisdictions, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience across hyperscale or mission-critical data centre developments, industrial power systems, or comparable high-availability infrastructure. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as an electrical subject-matter expert and design manager on multi-site programmes, and a proven track record leading design governance, quality assurance, and commissioning readiness across a portfolio of concurrent projects.</p> <p>This experience should include leading distributed, site-based engineering teams across multiple countries, managing external consultants and EPC contractors to global standards, and working effectively across the build-to-run interface with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations. Experience authoring or contributing materially to global electrical Basis of Design, minimum standards, or reference architecture at a hyperscale, cloud, or specialist AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia and Australia — under diverse regulatory, grid, and utility conditions.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Location &amp; Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Australia, or Singapore (with regular travel across the AI Factory portfolio)</li> <li>Reporting to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer | Voice | Full-Stack
description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally. You will join DeepL Voice , the team defining the art of the possible for real-time interpretation. While our Translation engine conquered text, Voice is conquering the physical world. We are building the "Universal Translator"; enabling fluid, real-time conversations for frontline workers, global meetings, and enterprise teams. This is a 0-to-1 engineering environment. We successfully launched our first customer-facing features in late 2024, but we are just getting started. We are tackling the hardest problems in AI interaction: How do you eliminate the "flickering" effect of unstable transcripts? How do you chain chunked inference to achieve sub-millisecond latency? How do you deliver a seamless audio stream that feels natural, not robotic?. You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional squad alongside Researchers, Product Managers, and Designers. We are not just wrapping an API; we are building the proprietary models, the streaming architecture, and the user interfaces that allow the world to speak without barriers. Your responsibilities A "0-to-1" Builder Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a roadmap to build; you need a problem. You are comfortable prototyping a new feature in the morning and refactoring it for scale in the afternoon. Product Obsession: You care about the flow of the conversation. You understand that "99% accuracy" means nothing if the audio arrives 3 seconds late. You optimize for the human experience. Ship End-to-End Features: Build and deploy impactful features across the entire stack, from high-performance frontend UIs to streaming audio services on the backend and AI inference integration. Tackle Real-Time Complexity: Debug and resolve challenging edge cases unique to real-time communication, including sub-second latency spikes, transcript flicker, audio glitches, and unstable network environments. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely in a tight-knit, cross-functional squad alongside PMs, Product Designers, and AI Researchers to scope, shape, and solve hard product and technical challenges. Qualities we look for A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code. Full-Stack Fluency: You're comfortable across the stack — building polished, modern UI in React and TypeScript on the frontend, and shipping backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (or a strongly transferable language, with willingness to ramp) on the backend. Real-time: WebRTC, WebSockets, streaming architectures, latency-sensitive systems. High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it. AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving. A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company , not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline . If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack . What we offer Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join DeepL Voice, the team defining the art of the possible for real-time interpretation. While our Translation engine conquered text, Voice is conquering the physical world. We are building the "Universal Translator"; enabling fluid, real-time conversations for frontline workers, global meetings, and enterprise teams.

This is a 0-to-1 engineering environment. We successfully launched our first customer-facing features in late 2024, but we are just getting started. We are tackling the hardest problems in AI interaction: How do you eliminate the "flickering" effect of unstable transcripts? How do you chain chunked inference to achieve sub-millisecond latency? How do you deliver a seamless audio stream that feels natural, not robotic?.

You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional squad alongside Researchers, Product Managers, and Designers. We are not just wrapping an API; we are building the proprietary models, the streaming architecture, and the user interfaces that allow the world to speak without barriers.

Your responsibilities

  • A "0-to-1" Builder Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a roadmap to build; you need a problem. You are comfortable prototyping a new feature in the morning and refactoring it for scale in the afternoon.

  • Product Obsession: You care about the flow of the conversation. You understand that "99% accuracy" means nothing if the audio arrives 3 seconds late. You optimize for the human experience.

  • Ship End-to-End Features: Build and deploy impactful features across the entire stack, from high-performance frontend UIs to streaming audio services on the backend and AI inference integration.

  • Tackle Real-Time Complexity: Debug and resolve challenging edge cases unique to real-time communication, including sub-second latency spikes, transcript flicker, audio glitches, and unstable network environments.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely in a tight-knit, cross-functional squad alongside PMs, Product Designers, and AI Researchers to scope, shape, and solve hard product and technical challenges.


Qualities we look for

  • A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.

  • Full-Stack Fluency: You're comfortable across the stack — building polished, modern UI in React and TypeScript on the frontend, and shipping backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (or a strongly transferable language, with willingness to ramp) on the backend.

  • Real-time: WebRTC, WebSockets, streaming architectures, latency-sensitive systems.

  • High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.


A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back.
